from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import os
import signal

repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe')
path=repo/'tests/test_real_forms.py'
status=subprocess.run(['git','status','--porcelain','--','tests/test_real_forms.py'],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
if status.stdout.strip():
    raise SystemExit('Existing edits in live forms test; refusing to overwrite')
source=path.read_text()
old='import pytest\n'
new='''import pytest

pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
    os.environ.get("JOBPIPE_RUN_LIVE_FORM_TESTS") != "1",
    reason="Live ATS integration requires JOBPIPE_RUN_LIVE_FORM_TESTS=1",
)
'''
if source.count(old)!=1:
    raise SystemExit('Live forms import anchor mismatch')
path.write_text(source.replace(old,new,1))
cmd=[str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','pytest','-q','--maxfail=1']
proc=subprocess.Popen(cmd,cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
try:
    stdout,stderr=proc.communicate(timeout=180)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
    try:
        stdout,stderr=proc.communicate(timeout=7)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
        stdout,stderr=proc.communicate()
    print('DEFAULT_FULL_SUITE_TIMED_OUT')
    print(stdout[-6000:])
    print(stderr[-1200:])
    raise SystemExit(124)
print('DEFAULT_FULL_SUITE_EXIT_CODE=',proc.returncode)
print(stdout[-9000:])
print(stderr[-1500:])
if proc.returncode:
    raise SystemExit(proc.returncode)
subprocess.run(['git','add','--','tests/test_real_forms.py'],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','commit','-m','test: make live ATS form integrations opt-in'],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','push','origin','main'],cwd=repo,check=True,timeout=90)
print('DEFAULT_FULL_SUITE_PUSH_VERIFIED')
